note: The continent: one landmass surrounded by impassable ocean. Towns are authored (data/towns/*.json); everything else is generated from the seed. Roads connect every pair of towns.
note_villages: 0.3.1 small villages between the cities (data/towns/<id>.json, kind village; data/villages.json). Not cities: distance bands, travel, markets and respawn use towns only.

road_rules.note: 0.3.1 A* road costs per tile: land 1, dirt/sand/marsh multipliers, lake water = bridge_cost per tile (a wooden bridge; ocean is never crossed). meander = moisture-noise cost wobble so roads curve. pk_cost keeps roads out of the Scorch. margin = search box around the two towns. max_bridge = longest allowed span (selftest).

decor.note: 0.3.8 fence runs (7 tiles every 6th run) + rocks/bushes/old logs (chance per verge tile) one tile beyond the road edge; 0.3.14 every 4th run (the re-routed roads round the bigger towns had too few E-W fences)

note_038: 0.3.8 (from Grok's world_capital.json, adapted): Highfen (data/towns/highfen.json, kind capital) sits at the continent centre. Main roads run town -> Highfen as 3-wide stone roads; trips between two towns go through Highfen (WorldGen._compose_capital_roads). village_roads are winding 2-wide dirt roads from each village to its NEAREST town (Grok paired cinderholt-barrowby, ~370 tiles apart; barrowby now goes to Saltmere and oxley to Cinderholt). Roadside decor: road_rules.decor.
